contract: The SidebarNavigation contract declares compact primary and secondary list geometry, nested navigation, and unavailable-item reasons.
pnpm contract:validate sidebar-navigation and generated contract checks passed.
implementation: SidebarNavigation uses 32px primary rows, 28px secondary rows, smaller token-backed insets, and a compact icon-label gap.
SidebarNavigationList level=secondary preserves nested list semantics and is hidden when the application rail collapses.
SidebarNavigationItem disabledReason provides an accessible description while disabled links continue to block navigation.
docs: The component README documents nested navigation, permission filtering, known unavailable destinations, and coming-soon states.
docs/ai-composition.md directs consumers to keep product permissions outside the package while using the documented disabled pattern.
stories: Default, Collapsed, States, and TwoLevel Storybook stories cover the contract states.
Two-level and unavailable-item stories were rendered and inspected at 375px, 768px, and 1280px without overflow or hierarchy issues.
tests: Four focused SidebarNavigation tests cover landmarks, current page, disabled navigation, disabled reasons, nested list semantics, and collapsed labels.
pnpm check passed 72 unit tests, three deterministic browser checks, contract validation, lint, formatting, type checking, builds, and package smoke testing.
